prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: 设置, a finished native raster UI art design for a cohesive Chinese Daoist chibi arcade fishing game, landscape approximately 16:9, high-definition hand-painted finish.
Input images: Image 1 approved mail UI and Image 2 approved team UI are PRIMARY visual-style references, not content or screen-layout templates. Match their rounded jade green / warm ivory silk-paper panels, fine warm-gold rims, soft cloud/ruyi ornament, precise painted edges and exquisite but restrained shading. Image 3 is the current approved fishing gameplay direction; inherit the ocean palette, gourd cannon design and shared control family.
Specific screen brief: 16:9 settings window 设置. Left tabs 音画 / 操作 / 其他. Main panel sliders 音乐 / 音效, toggles 震动 / 特效, quality selector 画面质量 with 标准 / 高清 and 高清 selected. Simple lock-target assist 操作辅助. Bottom 恢复默认 secondary, 保存设置 primary. Gold jade knobs, clear on/off states.
Composition and materials: produce ONE single complete full-screen game interface, edge to edge, not a collage or presentation slide. All controls stay inside comfortable safe margins. Jade/gold title and primary buttons, quiet ivory content surfaces and secondary buttons. Gentle painted sea/island background supports UI. Reuse the same border thickness, jade color, ivory paper texture, red-tassel accents and soft gold details as the approved references. Keep blank breathing room; decoration remains at the perimeter. Text and important icons must be large and clear, never cramped. Accurate simplified Chinese as specified, short lines only; graceful readable title lettering, clean body text. Include tasteful back or close affordance as appropriate to the requested screen.
Constraints: every written name and data must come from this screen brief; do not copy old reference names 青云小道, 桂枝, 长风, 云游子, 五行奇谈, old example levels, mail events, sender names or team lists. If player identity is shown use exactly 见习渔师. Do not add arbitrary labels such as 美术首稿 onto the screen. All values are visual examples, not externally verified gameplay mechanics. No foreign game branding, no watermarks, device frame, desktop environment, technical annotations or code. Premium original Daoist Q chibi hand-painted game artwork; no photorealistic people, modern flat dashboard, excessive glossy plastic 3D or noisy texture.
